book.name: 1 CORINTO
book.title: 1 CORINTO Corinto janinhahbo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Coriquinin noquen huetsabo yanapanti
Noquen huetsabo yanapanti coriqui sca tah hen mato yohihi, hea huetsabaan. Galacia mai janin noquen huetsabo hen yohini quescajaribiquin tah hen mato rihbi yohihi, man coriqui tsinquinon.

Hahan semana pehocohtai neten man cananipi coriqui texe mequexon bexojanahue. Hicha tahma cananipixon texe bexojaquin, hashoan hicha tahni cananipixon hashoan hicha tahni rihbi bexojaquin. Jascajanahue jatihixonbi, hea jano nocotaiya moa bexojarasihixon hinanti hahtipahscanoxon.
Jano nocoxon tah hen man caisaibo raantihi, quiricaya jaa coriqui Jerusalen janin bohabo.
Hea rihbi cati siripaiya ta hea manahi boyaxihcanihqui.
Pablonen cati shinanai
Jari caquin tah hen Macedonia nabebacahinyaxihqui. Jaa nabebacahinax tah hen mato sca jisi catihi.
Jaatian rah tah hen mato betan basi tahni hihtihi, jene tian huinonon caman rah, janohax hen caribicatsihquiton man hea cati yanapanyaxahnon, hea jano cacatsihquiton hen noconon.
Huinoquin res mato yohuanquihnbahinti tah hen queenyamahi, hea huetsabaan. Noquen Hihbo queenaiya tah hen mato betan basitihi.
Efeso jema janin pari tah hen banetihi, pentecostes fiesta caman.
Jano ta hicha jonibo nincamati siriscaiqui, heen rahuibo rihbi hicha jai bi hean yohihah nincayaxihquibo rihbi hichahi.
Timoteo mato qui nocotaiton sirijaquin bihnahue, jahua qui raquetaxma jan mato janin hihnon. Jaan rihbi ta Papa teexonihqui, hen hahcai quescajaquin.
Jaa ta beronan res qui hihyamanahue, tsoabi. Jan siripi hehqui joribinon yanapanyaxahnnahue. Noquen huetsabo betan jaa joti tah hen manatai.
Noquen huetsa Apolo tah hen hihti yohihipiqui, texe noquen huetsabo betan mato pasijahi cati. Yohihah bi ta rahma cati queenyamabiresipishqui. Hahtipahax tian ta catihiqui.
Huishaquin queyohi joibo
Coiramenahue. Papan joi jeneyamanahue. Yobacahinax coshin teenahue. Maton jointi rihbi coshijanahue.
Joni huetsahon shinanxon man hahcai jatihibi hahnahue.
Estéfanas, jaabo tah man honanscai, hea huetsabaan. Jaabo ta Acaya mai janin nincacoinmenonihbo qui. Noquen huetsabo yanapanti tee sca ta bihcannishqui. Jaa copi tah hen mato hihti yocacai.
Jato nincanahue. Hahbe teenicabo, hahbe yanapannicahbo jatihibi rihbi nincanahue.
Estéfanas betan Fortunato, Acaico rihbi nocotipi quen tah hen jenimahi, mato xahbanjaxon bi jato nincacax jenimahi.
Mato shinan hinanxon ta hea rihbi hinancaniqui. Jascapahbo honannahue.

Asia janinha noquen huetsabaan ta mato Man jascabi jayamahin hahquiqui. Aquila betan Priscilanen rihbi ta mato qui hicha joi siri raanihqui, Man jascabi jayamahin noquen huetsabaan hahquin. Jaton xoboho tsinquitaibaan jascajaribiquin.
Jatihixonbi ta noquen huetsabaan jascajaquin joi raanihqui. Noquen huetsabo hicocanannahue, noquen huetsa copi.
Heen mequemanbi tah hen nea huishahi, hea Pablon.
Noquen Hihbohon queenyamahibo jaiya Papan jato queyobahinnon. Johue, Hihbon hih tah hen jai.
Noquen Hihbo Jesusen mato shinan hinannon tah hen mato yocaxonai.
Noquen Hihbo Jesucristonen noque hahxonah tah hen matohon shinanai.
